ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark pigmentation across both lobes. Discrete high-contrast white mottling and speckling clusters detected on the distal half of the right lobe and along the serrated trailing margin of the left lobe. other_distinctive_markers: Significant water turbulence and spray (high-intensity white pixels) partially obscuring the lower-left ventral quadrant and the central notch area.
